value.rationale: The object is the natural first unbounded-marker family of binary words with isolated ones and positive zero gaps. The result completely reduces wordwise piecewise height to one explicit geometric invariant, provides the exact all-length fixed-weight height census rather than sample calculations, and identifies a nondegenerate fixed-weight limit law with exact harmonic moments. It generalizes beyond the prior two-marker census without claiming classical simplex-spacing identities as new. This is an interpretable structural classification, not a renamed calculation or an arbitrary finite slice.
